column5: [Feature][P0] Run the recursive meta algorithm as the executor of every answer: tasks, tests, drafts and solutions at each level
[Feature][P0] Formalize each requirement into a test in the requested programming language and run it before a draft is selected
[Feature][P1] Treat requirements as axioms: infer missing details and score options with relative-meta-logic
[Feature][P1] Reuse source code found on GitHub according to its licence: ideas only, public-domain copy, library, or licence-respecting file copy
[Feature][P1] Replace hardcoded solutions with meta algorithm executions for every task already supported
[Feature][P2] Formalization and deformalization (naturalization) of natural language through the meta language must round-trip
[Feature][P2] Configuration switches between valid options must change behaviour and be documented
[Bug][P0] Draft summary is written in Spanish or Russian for an English issue: language markers match word prefixes
[Bug][P0] File names from issue text are read at the workspace root and the session stops after three failed reads
[Bug][P0] A system prompt of one session is stored as a learned standing requirement and replayed in the summary of another repository's session
[Bug][P0] Work-item refusal is posted as raw JSON and the page chrome of a GitHub issue page is accepted as the issue text
[Feature][P0] Critical blockers of the vision: coding by the recursive meta algorithm and general question answering
[Bug][P0] A work item that only cites a Hello World repository or a source file name receives a stored Hello World program, committed and reported as "Created and verified"
